REMARKS
Status of the Claims
This amendment is filed in response to the Office Action mailed February 14, 2025.
Claims 1 through 20 are pending in the application.
Claims 1 through 20 stand rejected.
Claims 1, 9, 10, and 12 are amended herein.
Claims 17 through 20 are canceled.
No new matter is added.
For at least the reasons presented below, Applicant respectfully submits that each of the pending claims is in condition for allowance.
35 U.S.C. 112
Applicant asserts that the present claims, as currently amended, meet the requirements of 35 U.S.C. 112, and thus, appear to be in condition for allowance.
35 U.S.C. 101/35 U.S.C. 103
Claims 17 through 20 are canceled rendering these rejections moot.
Allowable Claims
As noted above, the 35 U.S.C. 112 issues are believed to have been addressed. Thus, claims 1 through 16 are in condition for allowance.
Conclusion
In view of the foregoing, Applicant believes all claims now pending in this application are in condition for allowance. The issuance of a formal Notice of Allowance at an early date is respectfully requested.
If the Examiner believes a telephone conference would expedite prosecution of this application, please contact the undersigned at 801-554-8311.
Respectfully submitted,
/Gregory C. Baker/
